title: Gene dfferential activity, snATAC-seq in liver hepatocytes, NASH vs. normal (Elison et al. 2024)
bodyHtml:
The plot and table display snATAC-seq gene differential activity in hepatocytes from individuals with non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) vs. individuals without NASH (Weston Elison et al., University of California San Diego, 2024, unpublished). This work was supported by the Foundation for the National Institutes of Health.

Only genes with adjusted p-value < 0.5 are shown here. Complete data are represented in the dataset DSR975PIP at the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
